seoTitle: Website Screenshot API: full-page PNG, JPEG and PDF
seoDescription: Screenshot any URL in a real browser: full page or viewport, desktop/mobile presets, dark mode, cookie banners hidden, optional PDF. Pay per screenshot.

screenshot.eventDescription: One page rendered in headless Chromium and saved as PNG or JPEG. Pages that fail to load are not charged.

pdf-rendered.eventDescription: One page additionally saved as a PDF (only when 'Also render a PDF' is enabled).
